fa14811212a34414b39fc59817f3e82ef355714d: A resort on a human scale, Avoriaz focuses on the quality of its welcome and its closeness rather than on impressive figures. Its 75 km of runs are perfectly suited to a stay of 3 to 4 days, especially for families or for skiers who don't need to keep changing their playground. Avoriaz's family reputation is well deserved: dedicated beginner areas, a well-run childcare service, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for laying the foundations of skiing with children. Avoriaz's altitude (1,800 m at the base, 2,277 m at the top) helps it keep a decent snow cover in the middle of winter. January and February are the most reliable months; in December and March, it is worth checking conditions before finalising a booking. A stay in Avoriaz is clearly expensive: a 59€ day lift pass, plus accommodation and mountain restaurants that are among the most expensive in the Alps. That is the price of excellence, but you should be aware of it before you go. In short, Avoriaz keeps its promises. A Northern Alps resort that will suit most profiles without disappointing.
